{{Quote|Force healing hasn't worked. One voice can't rise above a thousand.|Ren summarizes trying to prevent Killik joining|<ref name="FTB" />}}
'''Skohani Ren''' was a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the time the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] began. During the war Ren was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], where he attempted to help a [[Unidentified Organa noble|noble]] of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] who was being joined to the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Ren alone was not strong enough to help fight off the joining process, and he enlisted the help of an individual aligned with the Republic to distract the Killiks by attacking their nearby forces. The individual did as requested, and the resultant distraction was enough for Ren to help purge the noble's mind of the Killik influence and stop the joining process.

==Biography==
{{Quote|This man is in the process of being joined to the Killiks. I've tried everything, but he's beyond my power.|Ren explains his patient's situation|<ref name="FTB" />}}
Skohani Ren was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who had become part of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and been trained in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], reaching the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] by the time the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] took place.<ref name="FTB" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Ren was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where the [[Alderaan Civil War]] was being fought amongst the planet's many [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble houses]]. Whilst in the [[Apalis Coast]] region of the planet, he encountered a [[Unidentified Organa noble|noble]] from the Great [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]&mdash;a house allied with the Republic and the Jedi&mdash;at the Republic base named [[Wardpost Duvaal]]. The noble was in the process of being [[Joiner|joined]] to the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Species/Legends|species]] due to long-term exposure to their [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]], a process which would make him a drone who served them at the expense of his own feelings and memories. Ren attempted to help the noble fight off the joining process by purging his mind, but could not manage it alone against the many voices of the Killiks that were affecting the noble's mind.<ref name="FTB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Whilst Ren was trying to help the noble, he was approached by a Republic-aligned individual whom the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] asked to help him. He requested that the individual attack nearby Killiks and Killik [[Egg/Legends|egg]] clusters in an attempt to distract the species [[Hive mind/Legends|hive mind]] from the noble. It was Ren's hope that with the Killiks distracted, he could more successfully help the noble fight off being joined to the Killiks. The individual agreed and attacked Killik egg clusters and forces located near Wardpost Duvaal in the ruins of the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory|Mensaav Laboratory]]. As they did so, the noble managed to successfully fight off becoming a joiner with Ren's help and began recovering slowly. When the individual returned to Duvaal Ren, he thanked and rewarded them for their efforts with equipment and 2045 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="FTB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|If the hive was distracted, maybe I could repel them. A surprise attack or raid...but I can't leave him.|Ren comes up with a plan to help the noble|<ref name="FTB" />}}
Skohani Ren was a male Togruta with primarily [[Color/Legends|red]] skin and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. When he discovered the imperilled noble on Alderaan, Ren did everything he could to save him, and when he couldn't help alone he refused to leave the man and paid another to aid him.<ref name="FTB" />

==Equipment==
Whilst on Alderaan, Ren wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] and belt where he hung his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="FTB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That's it, then. Within days, he'll be a full Joiner. Another drone.|Ren's dialogue if players refuse his quest|<ref name="FTB" />}}
Skohani Ren first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. Ren is the start and end point for the optional quest "From the Brink of Death" for player characters in the Republic faction and gives different reward items for quest completion dependent on the player's class. This articles assumes that players did complete the quest so as to attain 100% game completion.
